data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:2: "\"\"\"Materialize the Reasoning Gym pool once, so no run pays for generating it."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:3: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:4: "**Why this file exists.** Reasoning Gym generates its tasks procedurally, so there are no"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:5: "bytes to download -- only a pinned pip version and a seed. That makes the pool reproducible"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:6: "but **expensive to render on every call**: measured, rendering all 89 usable families at 20"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:7: "items each (1,780 tasks) costs **15.6 s**, and at 5 items each (445 tasks) still **5.1 s**."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:8: "A dataset whose cost is per task hurts the control loop, the lint and every importing"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:9: "subprocess, never the run itself -- the lesson already paid for twice (skill doc §15.9 and"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:10: "§21). So the pool is materialized here, once, into `DATASET_ROOT/pool.jsonl`, and the adapter"

data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:12: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:13: "**The family list is measured, not chosen.** A family is usable here when, in the pinned"

data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:15: "answer scores 0.0, and the entry carries a non-empty answer. Of 106 registered families that"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:16: "left **89** (probe of 2026-10-08; the 16 excluded scored their own reference answer below 1.0"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py:17: "or accepted an empty answer, and `composite` cannot be built without sub-datasets). The rule"

data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:1: "r\"\"\"Reasoning Gym as a dataset: procedurally generated reasoning tasks, scored by the library."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:2: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:3: "    python3 data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py          # materialize the pool (once)"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:4: "    python3 data/scaffolds/qa/control.py --dataset reasoning_gym --oracle"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:5: "    python3 data/scaffolds/qa/control.py --dataset reasoning_gym --oracle --platform"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:6: "    driver.py --dataset reasoning_gym ..."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:7: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:8: "Where the tasks come from"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:9: "-------------------------"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:10: "`open-thought/reasoning-gym`, PyPI **0.1.25**. The tasks are generated, not downloaded, so"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:11: "the pin is three numbers rather than a file digest: the package version, one seed, and an"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:12: "item count per family. `data/datasets/reasoning_gym/prepare.py` holds all three and materializes the"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:13: "pool once into `DATASET_ROOT/pool.jsonl`; this adapter only reads that file."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:14: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:15: "**Why the pool is materialized rather than generated here.** Measured: rendering all 89"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:16: "usable families at 20 items each (1,780 tasks) costs **15.6 s**, and at 5 items each (445"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:17: "tasks) still **5.1 s**. A dataset whose cost is per task hurts the control loop, the lint and"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:18: "every importing subprocess -- never the run itself -- which is the lesson this repository has"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:19: "already paid for twice (skill doc §15.9, §21). The file is 3.4 MB and reads in milliseconds."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:20: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:21: "**Which families.** 89 of the 106 registered ones, selected by a measured rule rather than"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:22: "taste: the reference answer scores 1.0, the empty answer scores 0.0, and the entry carries a"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:23: "non-empty answer. The rule matters because a family that accepted an empty answer would give"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:24: "the do-nothing control reward 1 -- gate 2 red for a reason that is the dataset's, not the"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:25: "harness's. The probe and the 16 excluded families are recorded in `prepare.py`."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:26: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:27: "The metric, and why it is transcribed rather than reimplemented"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:28: "--------------------------------------------------------------"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:29: "Reasoning Gym **is** its scorer: every family's dataset object carries"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:30: "`score_answer(answer, entry) -> float`, and that method is the official metric. This adapter"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:31: "does not copy it. `score()` below rebuilds the family's dataset with the same `size` and"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:32: "`seed` as the pin and calls the library's own method, so a copy of the arithmetic cannot"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:33: "drift from the source -- the same reason `data/datasets/chessbench_puzzles.py` replays the official"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:34: "loop instead of restating it."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:35: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:36: "Two consequences worth knowing:"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:37: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:38: "* the reward is **not always 0 or 1**. Several families return partial credit for a partly"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:39: "  correct answer, which is exactly the property `docs/experiment_noise.md` found missing in"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:40: "  the binary-reward benchmarks: a task can move without crossing all-or-nothing."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:41: "* the check runs inside the verification namespace, which binds the interpreter prefix, so"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:42: "  `reasoning_gym` is importable there because it is installed for the platform interpreter."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:43: "  The pool file travels in `VERIFY.inputs` as gold; nothing else is needed."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:44: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:45: "The split"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:46: "---------"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:47: "The library publishes no train/test division, so the platform imposes one"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:48: "(`data/scaffolds/registry.py::default_split`, INTERFACE.md §2.3): a deterministic hash third of the"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:49: "1,780 tasks is the exam. `--split official` is the whole pool, because nothing here is study"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:50: "material from the benchmark's point of view."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:51: "\"\"\""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:52: "from __future__ import annotations"

data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:74: ""

data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:79: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:80: "def _rows() -> dict[str, list[dict]]:"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:81: "    \"\"\"The pool, read lazily and read once. `split=` below names the key returned here.\"\"\""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:82: "    path = DATASET_ROOT / POOL"

data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:84: "        raise ValueError("

data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:88: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:89: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:90: "def _question(row: dict) -> str:"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:91: "    return str(row[\"question\"]).strip()"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:92: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:93: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:94: "def _gold(row: dict) -> dict:"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:95: "    \"\"\"The reference answer **and the entry object the official scorer needs**."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:96: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:97: "    `Dataset.score_answer(answer, entry)` reads `entry[\"answer\"]` and, for some families,"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:98: "    `entry[\"metadata\"]` -- so a gold that carried only the answer string could not call the"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:99: "    official scorer at all. The entry travels in `VERIFY.inputs`, never to the agent."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:100: "    \"\"\""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:101: "    entry = dict(row[\"entry\"])"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:102: "    return {\"answer\": str(entry.get(\"answer\", \"\")), \"family\": row[\"family\"],"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:103: "            \"index\": row[\"index\"], \"entry\": entry}"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:104: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:105: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:106: "def score(prediction: str, gold: dict) -> dict:"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:107: "    \"\"\"The dataset's own scorer, called rather than copied (`prepare.py` holds the pin).\"\"\""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:108: "    from reasoning_gym import create_dataset"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:109: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:110: "    family = str(gold.get(\"family\") or \"\")"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:111: "    if not family:"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:112: "        return {\"reward\": 0.0, \"correct\": False,"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:113: "                \"why\": \"no family on the gold: the gold did not come from this pool\"}"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:114: "    dataset = create_dataset(family, size=PER_FAMILY, seed=SEED)"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:115: "    got = float(dataset.score_answer(answer=prediction or \"\", entry=gold.get(\"entry\") or {}))"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:116: "    return {"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:117: "        \"reward\": got,"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:118: "        # `correct` is the all-or-nothing reading, kept beside the partial one: a reward of"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:119: "        # 0.5 is a partly right answer, and calling that \"correct\" would hide it."
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:120: "        \"correct\": got >= 1.0,"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:121: "        \"official\": {\"family\": family, \"score_answer\": got,"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:122: "                     \"package\": f\"{PACKAGE}=={VERSION}\"},"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:123: "        \"why\": f\"reasoning-gym {family}: score_answer({prediction!r}) -> {got:g}\","
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:124: "    }"
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:125: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:126: ""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:127: "def _goal(question: str, gold: dict) -> str:"

data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:129: "    return ("
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:130: "        f\"{question}\\n\\n\""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:131: "        f\"This is a `{family}` task from Reasoning Gym. Answer with the value the question \""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:132: "        \"asks for and nothing else -- the official scorer compares your answer with the \""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:133: "        \"reference one, and an explanation turns a correct answer into a wrong one.\\n\\n\""
data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:134: "        \"## How to answer\\n\\n\""

data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py:136: "        \"what you wrote. Writing `answer.txt` in your working directory works too.\\n\""

The pool itself is not a download either: `prepare.py` writes it from this version plus the seed, and `POOL_SHA256` in `data/datasets/reasoning_gym.py` pins the result, so the only declared dependency is this package. Trap 1: the extras (`reasoning-gym[scoring]`) pull an LLM-judge cascade; the 89 families used here are exactly the ones whose scorer is deterministic and offline in this version, measured rather than assumed (see `prepare.py`). Trap 2: installing it pins `click>=8.3`, while a `ray 2.52.1` in this interpreter wants `click!=8.3.*` -- a warning only, and nothing this platform imports uses either.\","

/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/dateutil/parser/_parser.py:79: "        This function breaks the time string into lexical units (tokens), which"
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/dateutil/parser/_parser.py:80: "        can be parsed by the parser. Lexical units are demarcated by changes in"
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/dateutil/parser/_parser.py:81: "        the character set, so any continuous string of letters is considered"
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/dateutil/parser/_parser.py:82: "        one unit, any continuous string of numbers is considered one unit."
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/dateutil/parser/_parser.py:83: ""
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/dateutil/parser/_parser.py:84: "        The main complication arises from the fact that dots ('.') can be used"
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/dateutil/parser/_parser.py:85: "        both as separators (e.g. \"Sep.20.2009\") or decimal points (e.g."
